reuse.why: Introduces one createHolidayChecker in shared/schedules and routes all four places that built their own holiday Set (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange) through it.

duplication.why: Removes four copies of the holiday-set lookup; the only thing left repeated is the short `isWeekend || isHoliday` expression in the daily-skip filters, which was already there.

placement.why: The holiday-format rule lives in shared/schedules next to the weekend logic, and the server code imports it.

scope.why: Only holiday matching changes, with focused tests.

maintainability.why: A single documented definition of what a holiday entry means makes future format changes a one-place edit.
